comparison.statistics: paired circular block bootstrap of the Sharpe difference (2000 draws, 10-day blocks, seed 20261125), Holm over the comparison set, alpha 0.05 (protocol_v4_stats levels)

known_limitations: engine values a position that stops printing candles at its last close (optimistic); stuck positions are listed by stuck_positions()
benchmarks are daily-resolution; hourly use needs a separate registration
turnover and costs are estimates from closed trades plus open positions' cost
survivorship: the point-in-time universe removes survivor bias of the symbol list, not the venue's listing selection

legacy.t3_t4_rule: unchanged (protocol v3): T3 uses the best of B1-B5, T4 the lowest drawdown among them

btc_buy_hold.definition: buy BTC/USDT once at the first usable candle, never rebalance

cash.definition: never trades; equity = wallet; no interest assumed

cash_mix_t4.definition: static mix of the benchmark and cash whose max drawdown equals the T4 limit 20 % (ex-post comparator, solve_cash_mix)

exposure_matched.definition: equal-weight universe held at the strategy's own (lagged) exposure path, rest cash

pit_equal_weight.definition: equal weight of the point-in-time universe (S4 dataset), rebalanced at the first candle of each month; members without a recent candle are not bought

random_timing_null.definition: circular block permutation of the strategy exposure schedule (2000 draws, block 10 days, seed 20261125); one-sided p that timing adds value

simple_trend.definition: hold, equal weight, universe members whose last completed close is above their 100-day simple average; incomplete windows are not 'on'

parameters.source: fixed convention (mid Family A window), not tuned

volatility_matched.definition: equal-weight universe at a constant scale min(1, sigma_strategy / sigma_benchmark) (ex-post comparator)

volatility_targeted.definition: ex-ante: exposure = min(1, sigma_target / trailing vol of the equal-weight proxy), unknown vol = no exposure

note: Frozen registry. Legacy benchmarks B1-B5 are NOT redefined: definitions are hashed from protocol_v3.json and implemented unchanged in quantlab.equity. New benchmarks have new ids and run through the Stage 0 engine with the same ExecConfig as a strategy.
